mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where GDP y/y growth accelerates by > 1pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE drops below 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the year-over-year change in the industrial production index, signals a supply shock that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where INDPRO y/y growth declines by > 2pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in housing starts, as measured by the year-over-year change in the housing starts index, signals a weakening economy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 40% of instances where HOUST y/y growth declines by > 10%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 3%, it signals a tightening monetary cycle that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as credit conditions tighten.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises above 3%.

mechanism_narrative: When real retail sales decline by more than 1% month-over-month, it signals a weakening consumer sector that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 40% of instances where RSAFS declines by > 1% m/m.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises by more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months, it signals a weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending slows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where UNRATE rises by > 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate and the consumer price index both rise by more than 1% over 6 months, it signals an inflationary environment that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both rise > 1% in 6 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both rise by > 1% in 6 months.
